name: WordFamily
description: ONE Deep Mode word-family map: one corpus headword in one meaning (sense). Generated offline (generator-6), checked by the gate (gate-4.x), reviewed by a human. Deep Mode renders this row; the app reads approved rows only. Synonym/antonym rows are ALSO written to WordRelation later (source 'deepmode:<headword>') so the games can use them; this row keeps the display copy. Translations are NOT copied here: read uz/ru from VocabularyWord via word_id.

word_ids.description: All VocabularyWord rows that share this meaning (duplicate corpus rows).

sense_label.description: Short meaning label for the meaning picker: General, Money, River…

forms.description: Slot entries: {slot, status existing|other_meaning|no_form, form, relation, definition, example, register, note, not_family[], syn[], ant[]}. Main entry first per slot, up to 2 extras.

people.description: People & things: {form, kind person|job|field|thing, status, definition, example, note}. Max 4.

affixes.description: {affix, in_form, meaning_key, also[]} from the fixed affix table (affix-2).

relations.description: phrasal / phrase / function only: synonym and antonym rows.

gate_overrides.description: {msg_contains, reason}: gate FAILs judged to be gate mistakes.

gate_fails.description: FAIL count at import time (must be 0).

review_verdict.description: Human review verdict (Deep Mode review page).

approved.description: Human review gate. Deep Mode reads approved rows only. Only Tee flips this.
